name: Location info panels
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose Location info panels.
Select Add block inside this section. Use the supported block types listed below, then drag them into the desired reading order.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.label: Layout
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for layout. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Columns (desktop)
settings.how: Drag the control to adjust columns (desktop). Use only the range and increments shown below. Preview at mobile and desktop widths after changing spacing or dimensions.

settings.label: Show tags
settings.how: Turn on “Show tags” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.
